method: Three same-frame attack packets using actual R13/R23 hard and abyss enemy stats and the native mitigation/shield/fatal pipeline. Chimera has both physical and arts packets. Hodrer uses native S3. This isolates the instant HP pressure; enemy stun/aura/skill timing are covered separately by actual AI wave simulations. The single operator fixture supplies a nine-core snapshot to compare protection, not a full legal lineup.
